name: E-AG1 stage 0: premise-only census of genetic-pharmacological discordance cases
status: specification written before the census code ran and before any download; decision rules below are the registered AG-G0 rule (research/gated_plan/registry.json, c3d2345) plus two reporting rules stated here
question: how many independent target-gene clusters have a real discordance case with a feasible, context-matched measurement of the missing interpretation premise

case_premises: PRISM Repurposing 19Q4 secondary-screen-dose-response-curve-parameters.csv (broad_id, depmap_id, screen_id, name, target, ic50, auc, r2)
capability_metadata_only: PISA living-cell release (eLife 2024, DOI 10.7554/eLife.95595): compound labels from the cell-arm header and quantified protein identifiers from its first column; annotation sheet in_cells flag and curated targets
GSE92742 and GSE70138 sig_info: pert_id, pert_iname, pert_type, cell_id, pert_idose, pert_itime
LINCS 2020 siginfo_beta and compoundinfo_beta (downloaded for this question): pert_id, cmap_name, pert_type, cell_iname, pert_dose, pert_dose_unit, pert_time, pert_time_unit, and compound target
JUMP-Target-1 compound and CRISPR metadata (downloaded for this question): compound, InChIKey, target_list, gene
never_read: any engagement value (PISA log2 fold changes)
any L1000 or LINCS 2020 signature value or signature-quality metric (distil_cc_q75, tas, cc_q75, pct_self_rank_q25, is_hiq, sig_metrics)

case_rule.source: the engagement_v1 archetype rule (src/evaluation/engagement_cases.py screen_mcf7, ARCHETYPE_THRESHOLDS in src/evaluation/case_builder.py), applied to every DepMap model with PRISM secondary curves
case_rule.engagement_gap_or_mode: single-target PRISM annotation; curve r2 >= 0.50; target gene effect <= -0.7 in the model; dependent fraction (share of models with effect <= -0.5) <= 0.30; target log2 TPM+1 >= 2.0; fitted IC50 absent or above the 10 uM top dose
case_rule.screen_preference: one curve per (model, compound): MTS010, then MTS006, MTS005, HTS002
case_rule.reported_separately: the same rule without the selectivity clause (pan-dependent targets)

engagement_in_context.source: PISA living-cell arm; context K562 only; exposure undeclared
engagement_in_context.rule: the case's model is K562, the release assayed the compound in cells, and a protein of the target gene is quantified

proximal_activity_in_context.source: no local or downloaded release measures target-proximal activity across these compounds and contexts
proximal_activity_in_context.rule: counted as zero unless a release is found; candidates are listed, not downloaded

phenocopy_same_cell.quantity: transcriptional or morphological phenocopy of target loss; a pathway-level functional readout that the typed rules do not accept as engagement or proximal activity (BiologicalQuantity has no such member)
sources: CPJUMP1 CRISPR + compound (A549 and U2OS; design from Chandrasekaran et al. 2024)
phenocopy_same_cell.rule: the compound (13-character Broad identifier, else InChIKey for CPJUMP1) has a compound signature at <= 10 uM in the case's cell line, and the target gene has a knockdown or knockout signature in the same cell line
phenocopy_same_cell.declared_mismatches: time (compound 6-48 h against knockdown 96-144 h and viability 120 h) and perturbation mode (catalytic inhibition against loss of the protein) are recorded per case, not used to exclude

lysate_binding.rule: never context-matched; excluded as a premise supplier, as in engagement_v1

counting.unit: target gene (independent cluster); cases, contexts and compounds are reported beside it

decision_rules.AG-G0_population: biological validation of the agent is READY_FOR_STAGE1_PREREGISTRATION only if >= 30 target-gene clusters have an engagement_in_context or proximal_activity_in_context capability; otherwise NOT_READY (registered)
decision_rules.phenocopy_track: if >= 30 target-gene clusters have a phenocopy_same_cell capability, report a candidate task for a different premise (functional perturbation of the target's pathway). It needs its own premise type, rule and validation before any decision uses it; it does not satisfy an engagement premise
decision_rules.joint_task: E-JOINT1 needs one task with a genuine premise gap and a forecastable premise result or downstream readout with >= 20 reference cases per hypothesis branch (registered). References must carry an independent branch label; the census counts, per capability, reference pairs whose branch is fixed by a source other than the measurement itself

cost: no provider call; downloads recorded with source, version, licence, size and time; 0 wells
